models_evaluated: 9 electronic phenotyping methods (rule-based to data-driven), not named in abstract
5 bias mitigation strategies (pre-, in-, and post-processing), not named in abstract

links.outcome: Effect of bias mitigation strategies on fairness of pneumonia and sepsis phenotyping models
links.effect: Five mitigation strategies (pre-, in-, post-processing) were evaluated on 9 phenotyping methods; the abstract reports no quantitative results or direction of effect.
links.quote: In this work, we are motivated to bridge this gap through a comprehensive experimental study to identify the bias existing in electronic phenotyping models and evaluate the widely-used debiasing methods' performance on these models.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks bias across multiple EHR phenotyping models and tests five distinct pre-, in-, and post-processing bias mitigation strategies as deployment/safeguarding interventions to improve fairness.
